Cc: audit.team@helixpharma.com
Date: 2027-03-21T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: admin activity logs + extraction options for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Marissa,

Following up on our SIG response — the audit team has a couple of evidence requests focused on admin activity and operator actions for the past 90 days. Specifically we need:

- A manifest describing what admin events you capture (create/update/delete on tenant config, user provisioning, role changes, API key operations, model deployment actions, operator console sessions).
- An export sample (redacted is fine) showing the schema and timestamp fidelity (UTC vs local), and whether you include actor identifiers (email vs internal user id).
- Options for delivering a signed snapshot: S3 presigned, SFTP, or hashed manifest with HMAC (we run ingestion into our GRC tool).

Attached is the Helix SIG questionnaire excerpt and the fields we flagged. Can your team confirm what fields are present and the expected export latency?

Thanks — aim to close our SIG column by end of week.

Sanjay Rao
Senior Audit Manager
Helix Pharma

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@helixpharma.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity logs + extraction options for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front:

- What we log: tenant admin changes (roles, user adds/removes), API key lifecycle (create/rotate/revoke), model deployment events (version, rollouts, canary promotions), console operator sessions (start/stop, commands run), and policy changes (routing, fallback).
- Identifiers: events include both display email and an internal actor id; PII fields are redaction-friendly and we can replace emails with pseudonyms if required.
- Timestamps: stored in UTC with ns precision; exports can be normalized to ISO8601.

We can produce a 7–10MB gzipped JSONL sample manifest showing schema and three days of events within 24 hours. For production handoffs we support S3 presigned URLs (recommended), SFTP with SSH key, and an attested manifest signed with HMAC-SHA256.

Looping in Ben (security) and Kim (ops) to confirm export package contents and delivery SLA. I can provide the sample manifest by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Compliance 
Redwood Inference

Hi all — update and delivery options.

1) Sample fields: we will include action_type, resource_type, resource_id, actor_email (redacted), actor_id, ip_address (masked to /24), user_agent, timestamp_utc (ISO8601), request_id, kv_cache_hit (bool). Well include a small mapping table in the manifest that describes pseudonymization (e.g., marissa.cole -> internal_actor_003).

2) Redaction: for samples we pseudonymize email addresses and truncate IPs; for production exports we can provide a tenant-scoped export with full actor_email if Helix has a signed DPA in place.

3) Delivery: we can provide both: (a) an S3 presigned PUT link (24h validity) that contains admin-activity-manifest-20270321.jsonl.gz and (b) an HMAC-SHA256 signed manifest file (manifest.sig) for integrity verification. If Helix prefers SFTP, we can push to an SFTP endpoint with a user key.
